title: TB Detector
description: A deep learning system for Tuberculosis (TBC) detection from lung X-ray images using the EfficientNetB0 architecture.

problem.en: Classifies chest X-ray images as Normal or Tuberculosis.
problem.id: Mengklasifikasikan citra X-ray dada sebagai Normal atau Tuberkulosis.

data.en: 4,203 chest X-rays in the repo: 3,502 normal and 701 tuberculosis, split 80/20 for training and validation.
data.id: 4.203 X-ray dada di repo: 3.502 normal dan 701 tuberkulosis, dibagi 80/20 untuk latih dan validasi.

approach.en: EfficientNetB0 with ImageNet weights, fine-tuned as a binary classifier on 224 px images. A FastAPI /predict endpoint labels Tuberculosis above a 0.3 threshold.
approach.id: EfficientNetB0 berbobot ImageNet, di-fine-tune sebagai klasifikasi biner pada gambar 224 px. Endpoint FastAPI /predict memberi label Tuberkulosis di atas ambang 0,3.

role.source: README.md:107 (Kelompok 1 - Mata Kuliah Artificial Intelligence Semester 3)

alt.en: TB Detector web app: X-ray analysis form with the sample file Tuberculosis-560.png selected.
alt.id: Aplikasi web TB Detector: formulir analisis X-ray dengan berkas contoh Tuberculosis-560.png terpilih.

caption.en: Upload form of the web app, with a sample X-ray from the repo selected.
caption.id: Formulir unggah aplikasi web, dengan contoh X-ray dari repo terpilih.

title: Clash of Bang
description: A fan community website based on a dark fantasy strategy game theme, featuring community info, visual gallery, troops data, and a member registration form.

problem.en: Five-page fan-community website for a fictional dark-fantasy strategy game.
problem.id: Situs komunitas penggemar lima halaman untuk game strategi dark fantasy fiktif.

approach.en: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no framework or build step. Includes a looping carousel and client-side form validation.
approach.id: HTML, CSS, dan JavaScript murni tanpa framework atau build step. Berisi carousel yang berputar dan validasi formulir di sisi klien.

role.en: Solo, individual web programming course assignment.
role.id: Solo, tugas individu mata kuliah pemrograman web.

alt.en: Clash of Bang home page: navigation bar and hero panel with a Discover More button.
alt.id: Beranda Clash of Bang: bilah navigasi dan panel hero dengan tombol Discover More.

caption.en: Home page, run locally from the repo's index.html.
caption.id: Halaman beranda, dijalankan lokal dari index.html di repo.

title: Fake News Detector
description: An end-to-end fake news detection system built with MLOps approaches, covering data research, model training, and containerized web service deployment.

problem.en: Labels English news articles as real or fake from their title and body text.
problem.id: Melabeli artikel berita berbahasa Inggris sebagai asli atau palsu dari judul dan isi teksnya.
problem.source: Fakenews-MLOps-Pipeline Readme.md:8; Jupyter/AOL_ML_FakeNews_Research.ipynb sel 3 (full_text = title + text)

data.en: ISOT dataset: 44,898 articles (21,417 real, 23,481 fake), 39,105 after removing duplicates.
data.id: Dataset ISOT: 44.898 artikel (21.417 asli, 23.481 palsu), 39.105 setelah duplikat dihapus.
data.source: Readme.md:23; notebook sel 3 (value_counts, 44898 entries), sel 4 (drop_duplicates), sel 9 (31284 + 7821)

approach.en: NLTK stopword removal, TF-IDF with 5,000 features and Logistic Regression in one scikit-learn pipeline. Served by Flask inside Docker.
approach.id: Penghapusan stopword NLTK, TF-IDF 5.000 fitur, dan Logistic Regression dalam satu pipeline scikit-learn. Disajikan oleh Flask di dalam Docker.
approach.source: notebook sel 6, sel 10, sel 12 (pickle pipeline_model); Readme.md:16,18,29,32,35

result.source: notebook sel 10 output (Akurasi 98.58%, support 7821); sel 9 (test_size=0.2); Readme.md:37

title: Face Attend
description: Class-attendance system using face recognition (React, FastAPI, InsightFace), built by a team of 3. As a contributor, I handled InsightFace integration, the React frontend and API integration.
descriptionId: Sistem presensi kelas berbasis pengenalan wajah (React, FastAPI, InsightFace) buatan tim 3 orang. Sebagai kontributor, saya mengerjakan integrasi InsightFace, frontend React, dan integrasi API.

problem.en: Records class attendance when a student faces the webcam.
problem.id: Mencatat kehadiran kelas saat mahasiswa menghadap webcam.

approach.en: InsightFace Buffalo_L (ArcFace) embeddings matched by cosine similarity at a 0.4 threshold. A MediaPipe smile check triggers each capture.
approach.id: Embedding InsightFace Buffalo_L (ArcFace) dicocokkan dengan cosine similarity pada ambang 0,4. Deteksi senyum MediaPipe memicu setiap pengambilan gambar.

role.en: Contributor in a team of 3, all full-stack. My part: InsightFace integration, the React frontend and API integration.
role.id: Kontributor dalam tim 3 orang, semuanya full-stack. Bagian saya: integrasi InsightFace, frontend React, dan integrasi API.
